question: Does the old low-gate plus high-current predicate detect faults of the selected detector-driver-MOS chain?
method: Boolean signal observability table; physical currents and delays are not simulated
stop_condition: Compare old and proposed predicates across seven declared representative states once; retain common-signal blind spots
criteria: Normal commanded absorption must not be treated as stuck-on; off-command current must remain detectable when actual gate is high
assumptions: Command and current signals are valid in each explicitly assigned state
High current means exceeding the still-unqualified sensor threshold
Timing debounce and response are not included
